projection: native pixels: world +x moves 8 px right and 4 down; +z moves 8 px left and 4 down; +y (up) moves 8 px up. Draw a frame at (screenX - ax, screenY - ay), where (screenX, screenY) is the projected world position at ground level. Scale up by whole steps only.
frame_format: [x, y, w, h, ax, ay] in the sheet: rectangle, then the anchor inside the frame
